proposals.before: That is why the Grand Historian beat his breast to Heaven, wept his eyes dry, and still shed blood.

proposals.before: If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang jade and gold, Yuan and Yun abyss-sea, He and Han brocade and Milky Way—they are wandering dust.
proposals.after: If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang [like] gold, jade, and the abyss-sea, Qing and Yun [like] embroidery and the Milky Way—they are wandering dust.
proposals.reason: 淵海卿、雲，黼黻河漢 pairs 卿/雲 (Sima Xiangru and Yang Xiong) with metaphors; Yuan/He/Han are not person names, and 河漢 is the Milky Way.

proposals.before: Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who would divide a house as Zou did for Cheng's orphans?

decisions.reason: s0038 絳侯 is the marquisate title Jiang Hou (Zhou Bo); Hong Hou misreads 絳 as if it were 紅/洪, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct name.
The same 絳侯 in the literal of s0038 is Jiang Hou, not Hong Hou; the proposed replacement matches the Chinese title.
s0028 少卿 names Shaoqing (Ren An); Grand Historian would require 太史公/史遷, which this unit does not have, and the proposed idiomatic matches the already-correct literal.
s0094 謝朏 is Xie Fei; Xie Tiao would be 謝朓, a different person, so the proposed idiomatic corrects the personal name.
Literal likewise misreads 謝朏 as Xie Tiao; replacing with Xie Fei restores the correct name without other change.
s0106 子蒍 names the son 蒍 (Wei); Qian is unsupported, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct given name.
The same 蒍 in the literal of s0106 is Wei, not Qian; the proposed replacement matches the Chinese personal name.
s0107 復封蒍吳昌伯 again names 蒍 (Wei); Qian is a mistranslation, and Wei is the correct given name.
Literal of s0107 likewise has 蒍, not a name Qian; re-enfeoffing Wei as Marquis of Wuchang matches the Chinese.
s0166 溉弟洽 names Gai’s younger brother 洽 (Qia); He is unsupported, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct name.
The same 洽 in the literal of s0166 is Qia, not He; the proposed replacement matches the Chinese personal name.
s0238 張王撫翼於陳相 pairs title King Zhang with Chancellor Chen; reading 張王 as surnames Zhang and Wang invents a second person and misreads 陳相, and the proposed idiomatic restores both titles.
Literal likewise misreads 張王 and 陳相 as “Zhang and Wang” and “Chen’s minister”; King Zhang under Chancellor Chen matches the Chinese titles.

decisions.after: If the scale cannot lift and the gossamer cannot fly, though Yan and Ran had dragon sinews and phoenix pinions, Zeng and Shi orchid scent and snow-white, Shu and Xiang gold, jade, and the abyss-sea, Qing and Yun embroidery and the Milky Way—they are wandering dust.
decisions.reason: s0242 舒、向金玉，淵海卿、雲，黼黻河漢 pairs Shu/Xiang with 金玉淵海 and Qing/Yun (卿、雲) with 黼黻河漢; Yuan, He, and Han are invented person names. The proposal’s bracketing is awkward, so the metaphors are kept without editorial brackets.

decisions.reason: s0245 夷、惠 is the conventional pair Bo Yi and Liu Xiahui (柳下惠); Hui Shi would be 惠施 and is a different allusion, so Liu Xiahui is the correct identification.
Literal likewise misreads 惠 as Hui Shi; with 夷 it is Liu Xiahui, and the proposed replacement matches that reading.

decisions.after: Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who would emulate Hou Chengzi's virtue of dividing his house?
decisions.reason: s0273 郈成分宅之德 is Hou Chengzi’s virtue of dividing his residence; Zou and Cheng are a false split. The proposal names Hou Chengzi correctly but “divide a house with … virtue” misses 慕…之德, so the phrasing is revised to emulate that virtue.

decisions.after: Of all those arm-clasping heroes, those gold-and-orchid friends of old—not one wept Yangshe Xi's tears below the bier; who now would emulate Hou Chengzi's virtue of dividing his house?
decisions.reason: Literal of s0273 likewise invents Zou and Cheng from 郈成; keep Hou Chengzi and render 慕…分宅之德 as emulating his virtue of dividing his house.
